description: Per-prompt Claude Code activity from OTel log events: permission modes, skills, slash commands, tools and API requests.

panels.description: Developer prompts sent to Claude Code in the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.description: Prompts per day, split by the permission mode they ran in and the model or combination of models they used. 'Agentic' is Claude Code's default mode and includes sessions that never reported a mode change. Prompts that made no API call, such as local slash commands, are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  CONCAT(CASE p.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END, ' · ', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ')) AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND p.models_used <> ''
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Prompts per Day by Permission Mode

panels.description: Total estimated cost of the prompts run in each permission mode, stacked by the model or combination of models each prompt used. A prompt that used several models counts once, under that combination.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.`Mode`, m.`Models`, m.`Cost`
FROM (
  SELECT CASE p.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END AS "Mode",
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') AS "Models",
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost"
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) m
ORDER BY SUM(m.`Cost`) OVER (PARTITION BY m.`Mode`) DESC, m.`Mode`, m.`Cost` DESC

panels.description: Share of input-side tokens served from the prompt cache: cache reads / (input + cache reads + cache writes). Higher is cheaper.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.cache_read_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(p.input_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens), 0) AS "Cache read share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache Read Share

panels.description: How many prompts made N API requests, and how many made N tool calls.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.label AS "Calls per prompt",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.api_request_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "API requests",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.tool_call_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Tool calls"
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '0' AS label, 0 AS lo, 0 AS hi
  UNION ALL SELECT 1, '1', 1, 1
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2-3', 2, 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, '4-7', 4, 7
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, '8-15', 8, 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, '16-31', 16, 31
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, '32+', 32, 1000000000
) AS b
CROSS JOIN ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY b.ord, b.label
ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: Prompt Size Distribution

panels.description: API error rate = API errors / (requests + errors). Tool failure rate = failed tool results / tool calls. Tool rejection rate = rejected tool uses / (tool calls + rejections). Click a point to open the failure details on Claude Prompt Details in a new tab, with the same time range and filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.api_error_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.api_request_count + p.api_error_count), 0) AS "API error rate",
  SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0) AS "Tool failure rate",
  SUM(p.tool_reject_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count + p.tool_reject_count), 0) AS "Tool rejection rate"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error and Rejection Rates

panels.description: Wall-clock time from the prompt to its last recorded event, per day. Prompts with no model request, such as local slash commands, are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH durations AS (
  SELECT DATE(p.started_at) AS day,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.started_at, p.ended_at) / 1000000 AS secs
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT day, secs, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY day, secs IS NULL ORDER BY secs) AS pr
  FROM durations
)
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN secs END) AS "p50",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.9 THEN secs END) AS "p90"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Prompt Duration (p50 / p90)

panels.description: Which model or combination of models each prompt used. Prompts that made no API call, such as local slash commands, are left out. A combination lists its models alphabetically, and dated snapshots and [1m] variants count as their base model, so prompts that used the same models share a slice whatever order they used them in.

  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND p.models_used <> ''
GROUP BY REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ')

panels.title: Models Used per Prompt

panels.description: Compares prompts that started at least one subagent with prompts that did not.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.api_request_count) AS "API requests per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Slash Command Usage

panels.description: Prompts per skill, split by how the skill was invoked. 'unknown' means it was only seen on an API request or Skill tool call.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.skill_name AS "Skill",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'user-slash') AS "user-slash",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'claude-proactive') AS "claude-proactive",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'nested-skill') AS "nested-skill",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger NOT IN ('user-slash', 'claude-proactive', 'nested-skill')) AS "none"
FROM ai_prompt_skills s
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.session_id = s.session_id AND p.prompt_id = s.prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})

  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY s.skill_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Top Skills by Trigger

panels.description: Share of prompts per day that used at least one skill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.used_skill) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Prompts using a skill"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Skill Adoption

panels.description: Prompts, cost and tokens per permission mode, split by the model or combination of models the prompt used and its reasoning effort. Share is of all prompts shown. Prompts that made no API call, such as local slash commands, are left out. Effort 'N/A' means the client sent no effort.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE p.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END AS "Mode",
  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') AS "Model",
  CASE p.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(p.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(p.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS "Effort",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND p.models_used <> ''
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Permission Mode Breakdown

panels.description: Every permission mode switch, grouped by from mode, to mode, the model and effort of the prompt running when it happened, and what triggered it. Running /plan counts as entering plan mode; that prompt makes no model request, so its model and effort show 'N/A'. '(no prompt)' means the switch came before the session's first prompt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CASE m.from_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE m.from_mode END, ''), '(session start)') AS "From",
  CASE m.to_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE m.to_mode END AS "To",
  CASE WHEN pr.models_used IS NULL THEN '(no prompt)' WHEN pr.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(pr.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS "Model",
  CASE pr.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(pr.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(pr.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS "Effort",
  m.`trigger` AS "Trigger",
  COUNT(*) AS "Changes",
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
-- The prompt running when the mode changed: the session's latest prompt started at or before the change.
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p2.models_used, p2.effort
  FROM ai_prompts p2
  WHERE p2.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND p2.session_id = m.session_id AND p2.started_at <= m.changed_at
  ORDER BY p2.started_at DESC, p2.prompt_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) pr ON TRUE
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
  AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Tokens per Day by Type

panels.description: Prompts, sessions, cost and average tokens per prompt (input, output, cache read and cache write together) for each repository the prompt ran in, from the origin remote Claude Code reports, split by user. The Claude Prompt Details dashboard breaks this down further by model and mode. Share is the repository's share of all prompts shown, repeated on each of its user rows. Repository 'Unknown' means the session had no origin remote or the client did not report one. Project is the DevLake project that also collects the repository, 'Unmapped' when none does, or 'No repository' for prompts without one. Details opens this repository and user on Claude Prompt Details in a new tab, keeping the time range, project and team filters.

targets.rawSql:
-- base is every prompt the panel counts, labelled once; r groups it per repository and user.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.session_id, p.repository_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '') AS full_name,
    p.estimated_cost_usd, p.input_tokens, p.output_tokens, p.cache_read_tokens, p.cache_creation_tokens, p.used_skill
  FROM ai_prompts p
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
), r AS (
  SELECT repository_url, user,
    MAX(full_name) AS full_name,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens,
    AVG(used_skill) AS skill_share
  FROM base
  GROUP BY repository_url, user
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS "Repository",
  CASE WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(r.full_name, r.user) AS "User",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  -- The repository's share of all prompts shown, repeated on each of its user rows.
  SUM(r.prompts) OVER (PARTITION BY r.repository_url) / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.sessions AS "Sessions",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.tokens / r.prompts AS "Avg Tokens per Prompt",
  r.skill_share AS "Skill Usage",
  -- Details holds the row's filters as URL query parameters for its link, and is displayed
  -- as "Details". The Repository filter calls a prompt without a repository 'Unknown', and
  -- the User filter keys on the email or user key. MySQL has no URL encoder, so the
  -- characters that would break a query string are escaped by hand.
  CONCAT('var-user=', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.user, '%', '%25'), '+', '%2B'), '&', '%26'), '#', '%23'), ' ', '%20'),
    '&var-repository=', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(r.repository_url, 'Unknown'), '%', '%25'), '+', '%2B'), '&', '%26'), '#', '%23'), ' ', '%20')) AS "Details",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(r.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM r
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url is lowercased with the .git suffix dropped, so normalize repos.url the same way.
  SELECT TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url)) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  GROUP BY TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY r.repository_url IS NULL, 1, 3, r.prompts DESC

panels.title: Prompt Usage by Repository

panels.description: Per-user prompt volume, cost and habits. The Claude Prompt Details dashboard breaks this down by model, effort and permission mode. Details opens this user on Claude Prompt Details in a new tab, keeping the time range, project, team and repository filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS "User",
  u.team AS "Team",
  u.prompts AS "Prompts",
  u.sessions AS "Sessions",
  u.cost AS "Cost",
  u.cost / u.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  u.skill_share AS "Used a skill",
  u.command_share AS "Slash command",
  u.tool_failure_rate AS "Tool failure rate",
  -- Details holds the row's User filter value (the email or user key) as a URL query
  -- parameter for its link, and is displayed as "Details". MySQL has no URL encoder, so the
  -- characters that would break a query string are escaped by hand.
  CONCAT('var-user=', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(u.user, '%', '%25'), '+', '%2B'), '&', '%26'), '#', '%23'), ' ', '%20')) AS "Details"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share,
    AVG(p.command_name <> '') AS command_share,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0), 0) AS tool_failure_rate
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = p.source_connection_id
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY u.prompts DESC

list.definition:

FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'

FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

list.definition:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY 1;

list.name: user
list.query:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY 1;

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in. 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real
-- repository_url is always an https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '') END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
